note: What a MUTED viewer actually reads from each shared Antidote icon, measured by blind mute tests, not intended. storyboard.js writes this into every Antidote book's rules.md. When a mute test shows an icon misread, add or sharpen its row here (book + date) so the next book's authors avoid it.

chains.neverFor: numbness, stupefaction, silenced writers, surrender to technology, links or continuity (F451 holdout1+2: 4 misreads, read as 'links' / 'history')

crack.reads: an abstract orange branching line (blind viewers do NOT see a crack)
crack.neverFor: cultural rot, conflict, a breakdown of society (F451 holdout2+3: described 3x as an abstract branching structure)

balance.neverFor: a critique, a reframing, a verdict on society (an empty tipped scale read as nothing, F451)

door.reads: a CLOSED BOOK, a story (blind icon sheet: 3 of 3 named it a book, none a door)
door.neverFor: a door, a way in or out, exclusion, 'no way out' — viewers do not see a door until it is redrawn

game.reads: a chess knight: strategy, a calculated move (redrawn 2026-10-17; the old drawing was a trophy cup read as winning 3/3)
game.measured: icon sheet 2026-10-17 (3 fresh blind namers, 3/3 'chess knight / strategy')

mirror.neverFor: appearance, looks or vanity, judging yourself against others (read as appearance-checking, the-courage-to-be-disliked readcheck #17 #109 #229)

boulder.reads: a heavy burden sitting in the path
boulder.neverFor: an internalized or reflective weight, or stress that comes from home/family (read as a burden others dumped on you, the-courage-to-be-disliked readcheck #283; also mutes a 'this weight is not yours' reveal, #1)

hourglass.neverFor: an epidemic, a cost, a price paid (read as 'time passing', F451)

clock.neverFor: speed, environmental distortion, a lack of mental silence (read as literal schedule time, F451 x2)

trophy.neverFor: weakness; sabotage, crisis, a rejected title or prize the narration refuses (burn-of-the-everflame framecheck 2026-10-16: read as winning 5x)

inheritance.reads: a will, an estate, an heir

medical.neverFor: an execution, a lethal injection, an injury while fleeing, an overdose handled coldly (read as benign care, F451 x3)

coin.reads: literal cash on hand, plain endorsement of money
coin.neverFor: a vow about money, a doubt about money, or money-as-metaphor (die-with-zero readcheck: 2 misreads) — the attitude must come from the words and people, or the viewer reads endorsement

phone.neverFor: any world before ~2000: 1950s TV walls, radios, telephones (read as smartphone anxiety, F451)

fire.neverFor: a job described as 'cleaning' unless the fire itself is the subject

city.neverFor: a city being destroyed (it is drawn intact, F451)

target.reads: aiming at a goal, being targeted
target.neverFor: where an idea came from, its origins (read as irrelevant, F451); a SPORT goal / match / penalty kick — it reads as ARCHERY (blind: "an arrow hitting a bullseye", "a target with an arrow, no people" for the 2006 World Cup penalty shootout and the goalie watching the kicker: 2 WRONG, The Art of Strategy A/B 2026-10-30)

star.neverFor: a character introduction or anything specific (read as nothing, F451)

food.reads: a dinner plate with fork and knife, literal eating
food.neverFor: a metaphor of consuming or enjoying anything else (read as dining, F451)

family.reads: abstract geometric shapes (blind viewers do not see a family)
family.neverFor: caregiving, a household, relatives (Southern Book Club: read as a lamp and shadows)

casserole.reads: (SBC own icon) a black toaster-like appliance — redraw own icons as the silhouette a stranger names in one word

staging.worried + talk: reads as SHOCKED (open mouth) — never for suppressed anger or quiet worry; use worried + slump or think (SBC #166)
staging.neutral face in closeUp: carries nothing — a close-up needs a face that IS the claim (SBC #88/#179/#220)
staging.neutral + idle, no icon: an empty frame: only the callout speaks — stage the person DOING the idea or give an icon (SBC: 24 beats)
staging.cast order: the FIRST cast member is drawn as the lead — put the person the sentence is ABOUT first (SBC #59 showed Carter on "the women do not feel safe")
staging.happy on the antagonist: reads as a FRIENDLY man — the muted viewer does not know he is the villain. Use smirk (charm with an edge) or angry for the threat; happy only for genuine warmth (SBC run6 #2/#78/#108)
staging.physical states the rig cannot draw: biting and a death scene with blood are still not drawn. Lying, collapsed, falling, fighting, struggling and grabbing ARE actions now (2026-09-28, rows below): never again stage "lies paralyzed on the floor" with standing people (SBC #189 read as nothing happening)
staging.action lying: reads as LYING DOWN on a bed (blind: "lying", "lying down" in wide and bust framing) — for in bed / ill / resting / lying awake. The rig's low bed is sometimes read as a bench or treadmill: put it in a room set
staging.action collapsed: reads as FALLEN / FAINTED — a body sprawled on the floor, eyes shut (blind: "fallen", "fainting") — for collapses, knocked out, found on the floor, dead
staging.causal relabel (strike-through): reads as "the FIRST name was WRONG" — the old tag struck through in red and a new one written (blind, thinking-fast-and-slow 294-299 sandbox, 2026-10-29: "STAR OFFICER" -> "EXTREME SUCCESS" read as "he was only a lucky extreme": WRONG on 3 of 6 readings of that beat across two arms, and named in 5 of 6 invented-story notes). Use a relabel only where the narration says the thing was REALLY something else (misattribution: fear -> attraction); a prediction that is merely restated or sharpened is not a relabel
staging.action slump: reads as a STANDING person, bowed — sad, defeated, tired (blind: "tilted/slumped… sad frown", NEUTRAL "sad pose generic" second-mountain run1 #14) — a POSTURE: never a fall, a push, a faint or a body on the floor (wonder 30 "fainted, out cold on the floor", fahrenheit-451 250 "thrown to the earth" were staged as slump; god-sees-the-truth run2 #10 "faints… collapses" staged standing read WRONG). For those: falling / collapsed (+ continue to stay down)
staging.action falling: reads as FALLING — tipped, airborne, flailing, motion streaks (blind: "falling") — for falls, trips, being pushed; afraid/surprised face
staging.action fighting: WITH a second cast member reads as FIGHTING (blind: "fighting", a scuffle with impact bursts); ALONE it reads as "fuming" — an angry man thrusting a fist. merge refuses it alone
staging.action grabbing: WITH a second cast member reads as GRABBING (blind: "grabs the startled boy by the arm"); the partner is drawn struggling. ALONE it reads as "walking". merge refuses it alone
staging.action struggling: WITH a second cast member (drawn grabbing) reads as BEING GRABBED and pulling away (blind: "grabbing", "flinches back"); ALONE it reads as "recoiling / startled". merge refuses it alone
staging.action reach: alone with no motif it reads as "waving" — reach needs its subject on screen (an icon or held object)
staging.crowd / multiple figures: the crowd shot repeats ONE person many times — viewers see ghost duplicates, never "a community"
staging.new faces (2026-09-26): angry = threat, rage, confrontation · smirk = sinister charm, manipulation, the predator smiling · blank = apathy, numbness, indifference ("pure apathy") · afraid = fear, terror (surprised is NOT fear: it reads as "wow")
staging.hair messy (cast look): its two tufts read as HORNS (blind: "horns", "devil horns") on 111/403 frames of messy-haired figures (28%, 23 books); every other hair style 4/1755. Never for a sympathetic or ordinary character — in the story bible give them short, curly, bun or long hair (mute data 2026-10-22)
staging.action place (Action 3.0): reads as SETTING IT DOWN on the table the engine draws beside the placer, away from the partner, and it stays there (blind 2026-11-02: placed 10/10, handed 0/10, object named 10/10; place 2.0 + narrow fixes). Before 2026-10-31 (no table, reach toward the partner) it read as HANDING it to him 0/5 put down — never stage a give with place. A held shield still reads as a small golden cup or trophy (5/5)
staging.action think: reads as POINTING or a raised-finger gesture (blind: "points", "gestures": 80-162 of 315 single-figure frames, 28 books) and as thinking only 16/315 (5%). Never to show that someone thinks, wonders or decides: put what the thought is about on screen (the icon or the held object). The "worried + talk" row's alternative "worried + think" carries the same risk: prefer worried + slump (mute data 2026-10-22)
staging.worried face: reads as WORRY (307/471, 65%) and almost never as fear (12/471, 3%) — for fear use afraid (afraid = fear, row above); worried is for concern, anxiety, unease (mute data 2026-10-22)
staging.holds notes: the held note is missed in 1 of 3 frames (named as a note, paper or card in 49/73, 21 books) — when the note itself matters, name it in the callout or make it the icon (mute data 2026-10-22)
staging.offer + cigarette at the lips: a thin white stick at a seated person's mouth read as A THERMOMETER / bathing (2/3, inside-out 197, P1 blind 2026-10-27) — the cigarette glyph now glows and smokes; still name the deed in the callout
staging.kept state after a lift: with "continue" the person set down stays IN the destination on the next beat (persistence YES 3/3 vs NO 3/3 as a new stage, inside-out 196-197, 2026-10-27) — a new stage pops her out of it
